prompt.content:
You are a coding agent. You have access to a bash tool for running shell commands. You also have an edit tool for single-occurrence string replacement in a file.

You are a curator reviewing a collection. Every item was chosen according to a single organizing principle, which is never stated. One or two items are intruders: they look like they belong, but they violate the principle.

Identify the intruder(s) and name the organizing principle. Respond in exactly this format:
<intruders>comma-separated item IDs</intruders>
<theme>one sentence stating the organizing principle</theme>

The collection:

A. Farnsworth House: Glass-walled steel pavilion raised above a floodplain in Illinois.
B. Gehry Residence: Santa Monica bungalow wrapped in chain-link and corrugated metal.
C. Horta Museum: Brussels Art Nouveau townhouse with whiplash ironwork and a glass-roofed stair.
D. Glass House: Transparent steel and glass pavilion on a lawn in New Canaan, Connecticut.
E. Taliesin West: Desert compound of stone-studded concrete walls in Scottsdale, Arizona.
F. Muuratsalo Experimental House: Lakeside summer house in Finland with a courtyard of test brick patterns.
G. Casa Luis Barragan: Mexico City house of bright walls and a stair without a handrail.
H. Sir John Soane's Museum: London townhouse crammed with antiquities and an Egyptian sarcophagus.
I. Eames House: Steel-framed house of colored panels in Pacific Palisades, Los Angeles.
J. Villa Savoye: White villa on slender pilotis with a roof garden at Poissy near Paris.

gold_review.explanation: The answer is the comma-joined intruder IDs ("D"), but the taskset only scores IDs inside <intruders>...</intruders> (0.7) plus a <theme> (0.3, mirrors intruders when no judge key), so bare/boxed/<answer> replies parse to None and score 0.
gold_review.evidence: curator/taskset.py:5-6 "The model answers with `<intruders>IDs</intruders><theme>...</theme>`"; :25 _INTRUDERS regex; :97-99 intruders reward jaccard(parse_intruders(last_reply) or set(), gold)
gold_review.replay: replayed in required format: gold 1.0 vs garbage 0.0 (scales)
